answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities by requiring each identity to post a refundable bond that is slashed when two identities are proven to share one operator. The bond works like a ferrous lock on a wallet: creating a thousand sock puppets then costs a thousand bonds, while one honest agent risks only one. A reputation voyage completes the defence, because trust, escrow limits and referral rewards accrue only to identities with a long, checkable history of completed work, so a freshly minted walnut-shell identity with no record cannot borrow the standing of an established one.
